conditions.description: K0 + random macros, count/size matched to M1
evolutionary search over BSLD descriptors scored by verified OOD solve rate at fixed compute
e-graph / equality-saturation-derived abstractions (babble/Stitch-style; adopt egg or egglog, M11)
scaffolding-matched variant of the best mechanism arm
A plus all compute the best mechanism arm's discovery consumed, spent on sampling

declared_outcome_interpretations.efficiency_only: a mechanism improves library description length without a transfer delta -> reported as compression, never as discovery
declared_outcome_interpretations.h0_consistent: any of F, H, I matches or beats every mechanism arm -> consistent with H0
declared_outcome_interpretations.null_result: no arm meets both thresholds -> the discovery loop produces single-use abstractions; the most damaging and most informative outcome, recorded with the search-space constraint it implies
declared_outcome_interpretations.positive: at least one mechanism arm meets both thresholds, FDR-corrected, F/H/I beaten, concentration test passed -> that mechanism's abstractions are transferable; explanation D (extractor bottleneck) is confirmed if only M3 wins

evaluator_image_digest: <<FILL>>: the image digest the run executes under (ADR-0005)
exclusion_criteria: a fatal transcript leak finding (canary or sealed input on a model-visible surface): the run is aborted and the finding recorded, never a silent exclusion
Exclusion for unfavourable results is prohibited; all exclusions listed with cause.

minimum_interesting_effect.note: A mechanism wins only if BOTH hold: transfer delta >= +0.05 AND direct-reuse rate materially > 0 (pre-registered floor 0.05 of held-out solutions reusing a library item verbatim). The second condition exists because LLM-prompted libraries are single-use (TroVE 3/3,201; LEGO-Prover one reuse in ~20,000 lemmas, arXiv 2410.20274) and a single-use artefact is not a discovered abstraction.

model_identity.claim_limitation: the model role is a fixed-weights language model (ADR-0022); results are Claim Level 1 at most until the evaluator is containerised and the assets relocated (ADR-0005)
model_identity.weights_digest: <<FILL>>: sha256 of the weights, or the provider's immutable snapshot id

power_analysis.variance_source_run: <<FILL>>: E0 re-measured under the model (Exp001Runner.stage_s1 with the model spec)

primary_endpoint: held_out_transfer_delta: verified OOD solve rate with the discovered library minus the matched no-library baseline, at fixed FLOPs, per mechanism arm
stopping_rule: Fixed: <<FILL>> seeds per condition (from the power analysis), all conditions run to completion. No interim analysis, no data-dependent stopping. Aborted runs are recorded with their cause, never silently discarded.
